entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Diablo 3D candidate physical armor study derived ONLY from attached private ICURS 153, item.design.base.breast-plate. Do not design from its name. Compact sleeveless dark gunmetal breastplate only, rounded upper chest with open neck, slim dull ochre-gold edging along neck and outer shoulders, vertical pale-silver center ridge broadening into a transverse pale silver band across mid-chest (T/cross-shaped structural relief), small bright ochre patch at upper center, black side panels, short silver-gray lower waist flare divided at center and edged ochre. Preserve this simple compact silhouette. No sleeves, helmet, legs or extra large pauldrons.
Clean realistic HD sheet with EXACTLY FIVE distinct complete separated depictions: four large FRONT, SIDE, BACK, 3-4 views in a row, plus a fifth smaller NEW HD inventory preview labeled ICON beneath/right. Do not combine 3-4 and ICON. Fit every source piece entirely in every view. Neutral soft studio light, charcoal-gray background, restrained candidate metal/leather/cloth textures, no painted floor shadow. EMPTY item pieces invisibly supported, no person, body, head, mannequin, stand, hands or flesh. SIDE true depth; BACK is the opposite face of SAME armor with corresponding parts correctly rotated and no invented crest. Preserve exact silhouette, open spaces, segment counts, gold/silver/red/black blocks and construction across all views and thumbnail. Hidden back panels, thickness, fasteners and material readings are cautious inferences. The small ICON must be newly painted realistic HD of same set, never source pixels or pasted sprite. No scene, magic powers, runes, labels on the object, added weapons, class redesign or rig. Art study only; articulation, class fitting and rigid/flexible mounting remain existing character contract gates.

reference.notes: Referência nativa 6x inspecionada antes da chamada. Fonte privada usada apenas para silhueta/cores; pixels não incorporados.

inferredAreas: Verso, espessura, construção e materiais propostos a partir de uma vista; não constituem geometria histórica recuperada.

coherenceReview.observed: Cinco representações; torso compacto, relevo prateado em T/cruz, áreas negras e bordas ocres preservados.
pendingIssues: SIDE e quarta vista estão oblíquas próximas de perfis; confirmar seção do torso e orlas.
Patch ocre, rebites, couro lateral e verso liso são inferidos; não interpretar a cruz estrutural como emblema/poder.

entries.notes: Candidato sem aprovação. Thumbnail HD de estudo não é ícone runtime. Master/material, chão, rig/encaixe e legibilidade na grade lógica de 28px continuam pendentes.
